description: Land Acquisition - Keraminiya, Ambalangoda D/S Division, Galle District - Plan No. Tri 535 and FVP 29 of Abhayapura, Town & Gravets D/S Division, Trincomalee District - Errata to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1970/40 of 08.06.2016 by Welipitiya D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette exclusively contains notices related to land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (road widening), provides detailed descriptions of the properties (lot numbers, extents, boundaries, land types), and outlines procedures for claimants to seek compensation. The content focuses entirely on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
